claim_1.claim: RNA sequencing analysis of CD8+ T cells from 40 hospitalized dengue patients showed distinct transcriptomic profiles between early (4–7 days post fever onset) and late (8+ days post fever onset) phases, but no differences based on disease severity (DF vs DHF).

sources.quote: In the next series of experiments, we explored the signatures associated with the DENV-specific CD8+ IFNγ+ response in early (4–7 days PFO) versus late (8+ days PFO) samples, reflective of acute and convalescent phase samples.

Finally, we investigated whether any differential gene signature could be discerned comparing the DF and DHF samples. As described above, DE genes were defined by LFC greater than 1.5 and padj < 0.05 and the volcano plot is shown in Figure 4 d. Consistent with the exploratory PCA analysis shown in Figure 2 c, no genes were found to be differentially expressed.

comparison.finding: distinct transcriptomic profiles between early and late phases
